decisive_items: high-sensitivity troponin T of 275 ng/L (<14) peaking at 632 ng/L on hospital day 2
extensive patchy late gadolinium enhancement in a mid-wall to epicardial distribution
response.rationale: R4 is supported by elevated troponin, elevated CRP, and CMR showing patchy mid-wall/epicardial LGE with myocardial edema, consistent with an inflammatory myocardial process. R1 shares LGE but lacks systemic sarcoidosis features and is less specific. R2 is contradicted by normal coronaries on CMR and young age without risk factors. R3 is contradicted by absence of pericardial effusion/enhancement on imaging.

rejected.why: CMR showed no coronary artery disease; young age and lack of risk factors make ACS unlikely despite troponin rise.
No pericardial effusion or enhancement on echocardiography/CMR; pleuritic pain alone is insufficient.
LGE pattern is more typical of myocarditis; no extracardiac sarcoidosis evidence or other supportive findings.
